description: a leftover NUDGE_CONFIG_DIR whose Nudge is gone: the hook says so instead of silently turning Nudge off

expectStdout.systemMessage: Nudge is off for this session: NUDGE_CONFIG_DIR is set to {hookConfigDir}, but no Nudge is running there. It's only for Nudge's test harness; unset it to get Nudge prompts back.
